original_workflow_content:
name: TEST - Upstream development compatibility
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: upstream-compatibility
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.upstream.outputs.upstream_sha }}
      branch: ${{ steps.upstream.outputs.upstream_branch }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: upstream
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 scripts/upstream.py default
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: compatibility-upstream-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .work/discovery.json
  compatibility:
    needs: discover
    uses: ./.github/workflows/test-build.yml
    with:
      upstream_ref: ${{ needs.discover.outputs.sha }}
      upstream_branch: ${{ needs.discover.outputs.branch }}
      variant: both
      validation_only: true
# This workflow has no release job or write permission. Windows clients are never built here.
